name: openinterpreter
description: A coding agent for open models like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3

Duplicate agent response when using ACP server (e.g. via Zed)

discussions.title: Chopper: a small open model that cuts only the needed sentences out of retrieved text
Open Interpreter is included in the AgentManager tool catalog
grunz: chat + coding agent on abliterated/uncensored open models

cowork-to-code-bridge — async bridge from a sandboxed agent to Claude Code on your local machine

latest_release.body:
# Open Interpreter 0.0.61

## Models

- No model-provider catalog or request-admission behavior changes are included
  in this release.

## Release

- Attest Linux Open Interpreter archives and their checksum manifest in the
  original tagged build.
- Verify that original build provenance before publishing existing artifacts.
